description: Agentless Windows Server health checks over WinRM: one verdict per server, a diffable inventory, and no arbitrary PowerShell.

env_var_specs.name: WINDOWS_SERVER_USERNAME
env_var_specs.description: WinRM account name (a local or domain account in the server's Administrators group)

tools.name: certificates_list
tools.description: List certificates in a LocalMachine certificate store with expiry and days left. Optional: store (default: My), expiring_days. Returns array of Certificate.

params.name: expiring_days
params.description: Only certificates expiring within this many days, 1 to 3650 (e.g. 30)

tools.name: defender_get
tools.description: Read whether Defender real-time protection is on and how old its signatures are. Returns the Defender.

tools.name: eventlog_list-event-log
tools.description: List recent critical, error and warning events from the System or Application log. Optional: log (default: System), hours (default: 24), level (default: warning) (plus 1 more). Returns array of EventRecord.

params.name: hours
params.description: How many hours back to read, 1 to 720 (e.g. 24)

tools.name: features_list
tools.description: List installed Windows Server roles, role services and features. Returns array of Feature.

tools.name: hyperv_vms_list
tools.description: List Hyper-V virtual machines with state, uptime, checkpoints and replication health. Returns array of HypervVm.

tools.name: installed_updates_list
tools.description: List installed Windows updates (hotfixes) with install date. Returns array of InstalledUpdate.

tools.name: local_admins_list
tools.description: List the direct members of the local Administrators group with their SIDs. Returns array of LocalAdmin.

tools.name: pending_updates_list
tools.description: List software updates the Windows Update Agent finds applicable but not installed. Returns array of PendingUpdate.

tools.name: scheduled_tasks_list
tools.description: List scheduled tasks with state, last run time and last result code. Optional: failed, include_microsoft (default: false). Returns array of ScheduledTask.

params.name: failed
params.description: Only tasks whose last run returned a failure code (e.g. true)

params.name: include_microsoft
params.description: Include the built-in tasks under Microsoft (e.g. false)

tools.name: services_get
tools.description: Read one Windows service by its service name. Required: name. Returns the Service.

params.name: name
params.description: Service name, not display name (e.g. Spooler)

tools.name: services_list
tools.description: List Windows services with state, start mode and service account. Optional: stopped_automatic, state, start_mode. Returns array of Service.

params.name: stopped_automatic
params.description: Only automatic-start services that are not running (e.g. true)

params.name: state
params.description: Only services in this state (e.g. Stopped)

params.name: start_mode
params.description: Only services with this start mode (e.g. Auto)

tools.name: shares_list
tools.description: List SMB shares with path and whether each is an administrative share. Returns array of Share.

tools.name: system_get
tools.description: Read the server's operating system, last boot time, uptime and whether a reboot is pending. Returns the System.

tools.name: time_sync_get
tools.description: Read the Windows Time service state, time source, stratum and last successful sync. Returns the TimeSync.

tools.name: volumes_list
tools.description: List fixed-disk volumes with size, free space and percent free. Returns array of Volume.

novel_features.name: Confirm-gated service restart and start
novel_features.description: Restart one running service with services restart, or start a stopped automatic one with services start; each previews first and returns the service state before and after.

novel_features.name: Fleet health verdict
novel_features.description: One ok, warn, crit or unknown verdict per server, with the reason for every failing check and how long it has been failing.

novel_features.name: Inventory snapshot and diff
novel_features.description: What changed in roles, features, shares, local administrators, certificates, installed updates and VMs between the two newest inventory snapshot runs.

novel_features.name: Why is it down
novel_features.description: Stopped automatic services on every server, each paired with the Service Control Manager event that explains the stop.

novel_features.name: Who changed local admins
novel_features.description: Who added or removed each local Administrators member, when, and whether they are still a member.

novel_features.name: Health change feed
novel_features.description: Poll health-state changes between health runs with a sequence cursor.

novel_features.name: New errors on a server
novel_features.description: System and Application errors and warnings whose source and event ID are new on a server compared with its own history.
